title: Generate a storyboard panel in GPT Image 2.0 that includes multiple shots with…
content: Generate a storyboard panel in GPT Image 2.0 that includes multiple shots with exact timing breakdowns, then use that storyboard image as the input reference in Seedance 2.0 to generate a cinematic previz video.
tips: Generate a storyboard panel in GPT Image 2.0 that includes multiple shots with exact timing breakdowns, then use that storyboard image as the input reference in Seedance 2.0 to generate a cinematic previz video.

es.content: Genera un panel de storyboard en GPT Image 2.0 que incluya múltiples tomas con desgloses de tiempo exactos, luego utiliza esa imagen de storyboard como referencia de entrada en Seedance 2.0 para generar un video previz cinematográfico.
